authority_resolution.resolution: Existing authority permits dependency remediation and retains mandatory supply-chain controls. ADR0009 keeps the complete LGTM development/test stack; it does not authorize changed plugin trust. No applicable flow or domain FRD grants a signing-root override. Maintained rebuild consent explicitly excludes disabled integrity verification.

observation.signature: Vendor PGP MANIFEST includes executable file hashes; changing the binary invalidates the signed contents.
observation.coverage: Go-binary target present in a disposable scratch inspection image. Initial filesystem scan discovered no targets and is excluded from clean-scan evidence.

decision_boundary: Do not remove plugins, permit unsigned plugins, suppress findings, misclassify catalog plugins as core, alter the signing trust root, or lower scan severity. A compatible clean signed vendor package or a separately approved trust/signing ADR is required.
next_action: Finish independent CI and clean-image work; prepare a scoped signing design for human review if vendor-signed remediation remains unavailable.
